description.value: For the duration, every willing creature in the area shares one pool of Hit Points, one initiative, and every skill proficiency any of them has, acting as a single distributed thing. When it ends, each creature that participated gains 1 Signal Drift — including the ones who aren't Paradise-Touched, and who had no track to put it on until now.

cinderfall.incomplete: Shared HP pool/initiative/skill proficiencies among all willing creatures in the area; 1 Signal Drift for every participant, including non-Paradise-Touched ones. Pooling multiple actors' HP into one shared pool has zero rule-element analog, and granting Drift to creatures who may not even have the track compounds the Drift-track absence. The 0-10 Signal Drift track has the same absence as Bandwidth: no `SpecialResource`/counter representation anywhere in the corpus.
